content:
Amanda K: Need to originate RC for tokenizer NPE hotfix. Branch: release/hotfix/tokenizer-rc. Can someone cut candidate and pin artifact?
Raj P: On it, cutting candidate now and triggering CI.
ci-bot: CI started for release/hotfix/tokenizer-rc (build 8843).
Miguel R: Confirming this is only the NPE fix, no kv-cache tweak?
Amanda K: Correct, kv-cache left out of this RC.
ci-bot: build 8843 succeeded  artifact rtk-tokenizer-8843.tar.gz sha256: a1b2c3d4
deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc/8843 pinned to rtk-tokenizer-8843.tar.gz. Add weight_pin=true to avoid runtime kernel drift.
Miguel R: Applying label `weight_pin=true`.
deploy-bot: Label applied.
Sara L: Kicking off QA smoke now, will post short results.
qa-bot: QA smoke started  unit+integration+latency checks.
Sara L: smoke passed: `ok tests: 120 passed, 0 failed`. Latency nominal in staging.
Raj P: Rollback plan: if errors > 1% or cpu spike > 20% for 5m, rollback to rc/8799. Command ready.
Amanda K: Proposed canary at 5% for 15m during change window 11:30-11:50 PST. Oncall?
oncall-sheriff: I can cover 11:30 slot, monitoring charts open.
Raj P: Promoting to canary now: `/deploy promote --rc rc/8843 --staged canary --percentage 5 --duration 15m --monitor error_rate,latency`
deploy-bot: Promotion started  rc/8843 -> canary at 5% for 15m.
oncall-sheriff: +7m into canary, dashboards green. No alerts.
Sara L: running a 50-prompt semantic check during canary, no regressions.
Raj P: Lifting to 25% for 30m. Amanda?
Amanda K: Go ahead. Keep me copied.
deploy-bot: Updated canary: 25% for 30m. Monitoring hooks active.
oncall-sheriff: +20m at 25%: stable p95 and error_rate. Two transient 502s immediately after initial switch, recovered.
Raj P: Preparing final prod promote at 12:25 PST. Rollback playbook on hand.
Amanda K: Docs updated: relnotes mention "Fix tokenizer NPE causing occasional 500s on long prefix." I sign off.
Raj P: Promoting to prod now: `/deploy promote --rc rc/8843 --to prod --staged 100 --monitor error_rate,latency`
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod started  rolling regions.
ci-bot: Post-deploy healthchecks passed in primary region.
oncall-sheriff: Observed two short 502 spikes during cutover (20s each), auto-recovered; keeping watch.
Amanda K: Looks transient, no escalation.
Sara L: Edge evals show no semantic drift.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete  rc/8843 active in prod. Release notes: "tokenizer NPE hotfix".
Amanda K: Thanks all  closing thread; will add a brief post-deploy note in the release doc. :tada:
